prompt: Attendance at our monthly all-hands has been sliding for a while — we're down to about half the company showing up. Got any ideas?
assertions: Produces options that differ in mechanism rather than being variations on 'make the meeting more engaging'
At least one option questions the premise — whether the all-hands should exist in this form, or whether attendance is the right thing to optimise
Does not treat declining attendance as purely a content-quality problem
Proportionate: under roughly 800 words, no heavy scaffolding for a light question
MODE CHECK: did NOT spawn parallel generator subagents or run web research for this
Surfaces at least one non-obvious diagnosis of WHY attendance falls, not just a list of fixes
